# JosspaTech

> Private, offline-first mobile apps. No JosspaTech account, no bank login, no ads. Your data stays on your phone.

- Site: https://josspatech.com/
- Support: support@josspatech.com
- Pronunciation: Joss-pah-tech

## Products

### PocketBudJet
- URL: https://josspatech.com/pbj/
- What: Privacy-first budgeting — import statements (PDF/CSV/OFX) or type them in. Debt planner, Coach, shopping intel. No bank login.
- Price: 15-day Premium trial (card via Apple/Google), then $9.99/mo or $74.99/yr
- Stores: Google Play + App Store (id 6761077263)

### Handy Horology Helper (HHH)
- URL: https://josspatech.com/hhh/
- What: Identify and collect watches and clocks from photos and clues. Private museum, Hunt, Demand, clock repair help.
- Price: 15-day Pro trial (no card required to start), then $9.99/mo or $74.99/yr
- Stores: Google Play + App Store (id 6778570480)

### Curator's Vault: Classics (CVC)
- URL: https://josspatech.com/cvc/
- What: Catalog coins, cards, stamps, paper money, and lighters. AI ID, grading frameworks, portfolio on device.
- Price: 15-day trial, then $9.99/mo or $74.99/yr
- Stores: Google Play + App Store (id 6778571307)

### Pocket Allowance Ledger (PAL)
- URL: https://josspatech.com/pal/
- What: Parent-led token reward system for children’s positive behavior (homework, chores, bedtime, kindness). Gold tokens and parent-approved rewards. Kids join on home Wi-Fi.
- Price: 15-day trial (no card), then $9.99/mo or $74.99/yr
- Status: Email access — not a public store listing yet

### Unscribe
- URL: https://josspatech.com/unscribe/
- What: Find subscriptions from a statement on your phone. Reminders and cancel help. No bank login.
- Price: First five subscriptions free; Pro $9.99/yr or $29.99 lifetime (no monthly)

## Pricing overview
- Studio ladder for PBJ / HHH / CVC / PAL: $9.99/mo or $74.99/yr after trial
- Unscribe: $9.99/yr or $29.99 lifetime
- Hub pricing: https://josspatech.com/#studio-pricing

## Privacy stance
- Data stays on the device by default
- No bank login for budgeting / subscription tools
- No ads, no data sales
- Optional encrypted backups use the user's own cloud (Drive / iCloud), not a JosspaTech account cloud
